records.title: FORM 10-Q - Q2 2022
records.text: •Net sales were $318.2 million, an increase of 14.6%

records.title: FORM 10-Q - Q2 2022
records.text: We experienced continual strengthening of our backlog of orders throughout 2021, which has continued to grow during the first half of 2022 across our global organization.

records.title: FORM 10-Q - Q2 2022
records.text: COVID-19 Pandemic – Our business has been significantly affected by the contributory effects of the COVID-19 pandemic such as fluctuations in demand for our products, material price increases, increased shipping costs and lead times from production materials, supplies and parts, labor shortages and increased labor costs.

records.title: FORM 10-Q - Q2 2022
records.text: The purchase price of $19.3 million was paid in cash.

records.title: FORM 10-Q - Q2 2022
records.text: •Income from operations decreased $14.3 million to a loss of $4.0 million
